c5n_plateau_fact.statement: R5, R6, R8, R12 and R16 are nearly identical on the major fresh high-resolution B14 dynamic-head groundwater errors.
c5n_plateau_fact.implication: Increasing total dimension by adding layers above the already-resolved lower cells does not improve the response.

what_c5n_does_not_test: Thinning the bottom-adjacent layer below 10 cm at fixed state dimension.
Redistributing a fixed state budget from upper/middle zones into the bottom 10-20 cm.
A physically distinct inter-layer or storage-consistent boundary closure.

c5c_prior.statement: On the earlier B14 dynamic-head workload, bottom-only spatial refinement from a 10-cm bottom cell to 5-cm and 2.5-cm cells changed LARE bottom-flux response strongly.
c5c_prior.caveat: C5C used a then-insufficiently-refined Reference and changed total state dimension, so it is mechanism evidence, not a high-resolution sufficiency result.

c5j_c5k_boundary_audit.statement: Reference prescribed-head boundary formulation is sensitive, but theory-derived Reference boundary alternatives did not justify replacing current Reference G0K0.
c5j_c5k_boundary_audit.implication: This supports retaining Reference physics. It does not prove that a 10-cm aggregated LARE bottom-layer storage can be treated as a point center state.

closure_reconciliation.C4H: Internal qi residual was gradient-component dominant; interface conductivity error was smaller.
closure_reconciliation.C4K: Existing-state evidence did not justify adding a memory/history state.
closure_reconciliation.C4L: qH-preserving cubic storage reconstruction was mixed across width/direction and not propagated.
closure_reconciliation.C4M: Parameter-free central interface gradient was not supported where interpretable.
closure_reconciliation.C4N: Face-interpolated geometry-only amplitude correction improved FALL but worsened RISE/HOLD; no propagation.
closure_reconciliation.C4O: No single existing-state scalar conditioner transferred across widths; further scalar tuning is forbidden.
closure_reconciliation.conclusion: Simple scalar/shape retuning of CURRENT_LAYER_FACE-related gradient reconstruction is closed. A genuinely different nonlinear flux closure remains scientifically open, but C5N does not yet prove it is necessary because bottom-adjacent state placement was held fixed at 10 cm.

representation_conclusion.next_discriminator: Fixed-dimension bottom-focused partition redistribution under unchanged BC1 CURRENT_LAYER_FACE on fresh B14 dynamic-head histories.

next_authority.question: At the same total state dimension, does reallocating layers from the upper/middle column into progressively thinner bottom-adjacent layers materially reduce high-resolution B14 dynamic-head error under unchanged CURRENT_LAYER_FACE closure?
design_principles: Use fresh response-blind B14 prescribed-head histories not used in C5A or C5N.
Keep CURRENT_LAYER_FACE and all constitutive/numerical settings fixed.
Compare equal-dimension partition pairs so state count is controlled while bottom-cell thickness/placement changes.
Include at least dimension-4 and dimension-8 pairs because placement effects already replicated at those dimensions.
Use R1024/R2048 T16 current Reference plus R2048 T8 temporal control under the same high-resolution qualification logic as C5N.
No response-based boundary optimization; partition coordinates are frozen before execution.
If bottom-focused redistribution materially improves but still misses comparator frontiers, report continuous improvement and only then reconsider closure.
If it does not improve, the evidence basis for a physically distinct closure family becomes substantially stronger.

explicitly_closed: More scalar tuning of the same fixed-partition gradient closure.
Selecting a universal minimum layer count from C4/C5A/C5N.
Treating C5N's R5-R16 plateau as proof that state placement cannot help.
Application acceptance, performance or speed claims.
